title: Remembering a rescue
odia: ଭାସି ଯାଉଥିଲୁ ମଝିନଇରେ ଧରି ଆଣିଥିଲି ତତେ, ଠାକୁଆ ଗାଲରେ ମାଉଁଶ ଲାଗିଲା ଜବାବ ଦେଉଛୁ ମତେ
literal_meaning: I pulled you from the river; now your hollow cheeks have filled out and you answer me back.
explanation: The speaker resents defiance from someone previously helped. The rescue creates the contrast between former dependence and present confidence.
meaning_odia: ବିପଦରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ପାଇ ଅବସ୍ଥା ସୁଧୁରିବା ପରେ ସେହି ସାହାଯ୍ୟକାରୀଙ୍କୁ ଜବାବ ଦେବା ନେଇ ବକ୍ତା ଅଭିମାନ କରୁଛନ୍ତି।
usage_example: A mentor complains when a former trainee openly challenges a decision. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Editorial interpretation of an unglossed witness. Receiving help does not remove a person’s right to disagree.
